rules.name: By Ysgramor!
rules.description: Friendly Companions within 3" of Kodlak may replace one die from their Armor Rating rolls with [RED].

rules.name: Harbinger's Decree
rules.description: Once per game, as a Special Action, Kodlak may grant one Extra Action to all friendly Companions within 6".

rules.name: Honour to the Companions!
rules.description: If Kodlak Whitemane is included in the same Party, and is removed as a casualty, Skjor immediately becomes the Party Champion for all rules purposes, gaining Kodlak's "By Ysgramor!" special rule.

rules.name: Beast-Hunter
rules.description: Aela's Ranged Attacks gain [GREEN] when targeting enemies of the Beast or Monster type.

rules.name: Arachnophobia
rules.description: Farkas treats Spiders of all types as though they have the Terrifying Keyword.

rules.name: Strongman
rules.description: If Farkas ends his activation Engaged, he may choose one enemy in [base] contact. That model must pass a Strength Attribute Test, or be pushed [BLACK] inches away from Farkas, following the rules for Force Attacks.
